newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-FRANCE DOMINATE PORTUGAL TO WIN 2-0.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRANCE DOMINATE PORTUGAL TO WIN 2-0.

text.p: A superb solo effort by Bordeaux's Ibrahima Ba crowned an impressive 2-0 win for France over Portugal in a friendly international on Wednesday.
Ba beat Barcelona central defender Fernando Couto on the left before cutting into the area and pushing the ball wide of Victor Baia in the Portuguese goal.
The goal after 60 minutes was just reward for the control the talented French excercised for most of the match played in this northern city.
Didier Deschamps had opened the scoring for the French after just 10 minutes, taking advantage of a howling error by the Portuguese defence.

AC Milan striker Christophe Dugarry was put through in the area but instead of shooting he unselfishly slipped the ball to Deschamps who scored with the Portuguese defence looking helplessly for an offside.
Portugal's best chance came in the closing minutes when Domingos Oliveira fired wide from right in front of goal.
